description: This horizontal grouped bar chart illustrates numerical values associated with different categories of "Optimisations applied" across two distinct models. The vertical category axis is labeled "Optimisations applied" and lists the categories from top to bottom as "Normalised", "Add Spacing", "Remove Spacing", "Americanisms", and "Dates". The horizontal value axis lacks a specific text label but features a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to slightly above 0.003, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 0.001. A legend positioned below the chart, titled "Model", indicates that the orange bars represent the "NESAC ft model" and the green bars represent the "SESHA ft model". Within each category on the vertical axis, the bars are grouped in pairs, with the orange bar positioned above the green bar. Every bar is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact numerical value at its right end. For the "Normalised" category, the orange bar has a value of 0.00334, which is the highest value for the NESAC ft model, and the green bar is 0.00323. In the "Add Spacing" category, the orange bar is 0.00319 and the green bar reaches 0.00344, representing the highest value for the SESHA ft model. The "Remove Spacing" category shows an orange bar at 0.00311 and a green bar at 0.00306. For "Americanisms", the orange bar is 0.00299 and the green bar is 0.00302. Finally, the "Dates" category contains the shortest bars for both models, with the orange bar at 0.00257 and the green bar at 0.00228. The categories appear to be ordered in a generally descending manner from top to bottom based on the overall magnitude of the values.
